customtooltips.tooltip_list_screen.title: Manage Tooltips
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.title: Edit Tooltip [Hold CTRL for Live Preview]
Tooltip Background Options
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.targe:
Accepts exact IDs §c(minecraft:apple)§f, tags §6(#c:swords)§f, namespaces §e(minecraft:*)§f, regex §a(regex:.*_sword)§f, or all items §b(*)§f.

§eNote:§r§f Tags are world-specific and will only appear in the dropdown after loading a world.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.custo:
Inline color/formatting codes (e.g., §c&c§r, §l&l§r) only work with the Solid style. Use the toggles below for gradient text formatting.

§eTip:§r Use dynamic placeholders like §b%max_durability%§r, §b%weapon_damage%§r or §b%enchantments%§r, and embed keybinds using §b<key:translation.key>§r (e.g. §b<key:key.forward>§r -> §b[W]§r).

§eNote:§r Check the mod's Wiki page for the full list of placeholders! (WIP)
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.style:
The rendering and animation style.

§6Solid:§r Single static color.
§6Static Gradient:§r Fixed gradient between two colors.
§6Slide Gradient:§r Animated gradient between two colors.
§6Breathing Gradient:§r Fixed gradient that pulsates back and forth.
§6Rainbow:§r Animated flowing rainbow.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.color: Choose the primary color using the visual picker.
Choose the secondary color (used for Gradients) using the visual picker.

Also accepts manual input of colors.

Valid formats:
§7Minecraft color names (e.g. '§6gold§7')
Legacy formatting codes (e.g. '§d&d§7')
Hex color codes: §c#FF0000§7, §a00FF00§7, §b0x0000FF§7, §ex0000FF§7
The color of the top part of the tooltip's border. Creates a gradient with the bottom color.
The color of the bottom part of the tooltip's border. Creates a gradient with the top color.
The color of the top part of the tooltip's background. Creates a gradient with the bottom color.
The color of the bottom part of the tooltip's background. Creates a gradient with the top color.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.backg:
The background type of the tooltip.

§6Solid:§r Single static color.
§6Gradient:§r Fixed gradient between two colors.
§6Texture (Stretch):§r Stretches the entire image to fit the tooltip. Best for seamless patterns, noisy backgrounds, or large abstract images.
§6Texture (Framed):§r Uses smart scaling (Nine-Slice). Corners and borders keep their original thickness while the center stretches. Best for RPG frames, custom UI boxes, or drawn borders.

The texture to use for the background. Place .png files in config/custom_tooltip_api/backgrounds/.

§eNote:§r For 'Framed' mode, textures are mapped to a 64x64 grid with 8px corners. You can use larger HD images (e.g., 128x128 with 16px corners) as long as the proportions match!

§bTip:§r Translucency and semi-transparent pixels are fully supported.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.posit:
Top §7(Under the item's name)§r
Bottom §7(Bottom of the tooltip)§r
Replace Name §7(Replaces the item's name)§r
Replace All §7(Replaces the entire tooltip)§r
Append §7(End of a line)§r
Prepend §7(Start of a line)§r
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.line_:
Offsets the line position in the tooltip.
Accepts positive integers if position is set to §6Top§r, §6Replace Name§r, §6Append§r, §6Prepend§r, or negative integers if position is set to §6Bottom§r.
The font ID to use. Leave as 'minecraft:default' for the default font.

§4Note: The custom Resource Pack needs to be enabled!
If the displayed text should be §lbold§r.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.itali: If the displayed text should be §oitalic§r.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.under: If the displayed text should be §nunderlined§r.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.strik: If the displayed text should be §mstrikethrough§r.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.obfus: If the displayed text should be §kobfuscated§r (obfuscated).
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.requi:
If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when holding the secondary details key (Default: Shift).

§eNote:§r You can rebind this key in Minecraft's Controls menu.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.empty: Adds an empty line before the tooltip.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.anima: Animation offset that desynchronizes different animations.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.tickr:
Cycle duration of the animation.
100 is normal speed, 50 is fast, 200 is slow.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.rever:
Reverses the animation of the gradient.
Only works with §6Slide§r, §6Breathing§r, and §6Rainbow§r gradients.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.hide_:
If enabled, removes all default vanilla lore and stats from the item before injecting this custom tooltip.

§eTip:§r Great for completely redesigning an item's description from scratch.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.show_: If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when the item has lost durability.
If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when the item has at least one enchantment.
If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when the item possesses the Unbreakable tag.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.backg:
Adjusts the transparency of the tooltip's background.

§eNote:§r 255 is fully opaque, 0 is fully transparent. Default is 240.
customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.borde:
Adjusts the transparency of the tooltip's borders.

§eNote:§r 255 is fully opaque, 0 is fully transparent. Default is 240.
